title: CPC-2025-5792-DB-PR
text:
CPC-2025-5792-DB-PR  Council District: 13 – Soto-Martinez
  CEQA: ENV-2025-5791-SE  Last Day to Act: 11-12-26
  Related Case: VTT-84600-1A
  Plan Area: Hollywood

  PUBLIC HEARING – Completed April 29, 2026

  PROJECT SITE:  1350 – 1362 North Western Avenue; 1377 North Serrano Avenue;
  5433 – 5499 West Fernwood Avenue

  The Department of City Planning is requesting that the matter be continued to a date certain of January
  14, 2027.

  PROPOSED PROJECT:
  Demolition of an existing surface parking lot and a parking structure and the construction, use, and
  maintenance of a new eight-story, 85-foot tall, 302,979 square-foot mixed-use building with 251 residential
  units, of which 21 units will be reserved for Very Low Income Households, and 2,489 square-feet of ground
  floor commercial space.

  REQUESTED ACTIONS:
  1. A Statutory Exemption from California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) pursuant to California Public
  Resource Code Section 21080.66 (Assembly Bill 130);
  2. Pursuant to Chapter 1 Section 12.22 A.37 and Chapter 1A Section 13B.2.3 of the Los Angeles Municipal
  Code (LAMC), and Assembly Bill (AB) 1287, a Density Bonus to allow a 34 percent density increase to
  allow the construction of a new mixed-use building with 251 dwelling units, including 21 units reserved for
  Very Low Income Households, with the following requested On-Menu Incentives and Waivers or
  Modifications of Development Standards:
  a. An On-Menu Incentive to allow averaging of floor area ratio, density, parking, or open space, and
  permitting vehicular access across the entire project site;
  b. An On-Menu Incentive to allow a 47 percent increase in Floor Area Ratio (FAR) to permit a FAR of
  2.2:1 in lieu of 1.5:1;
  c. A Waiver of Development Standards to allow a reduction in the residential side yard setback along
  Fernwood Avenue to permit five feet and six inches in lieu of 11 feet;
  d. A Waiver of Development Standards to allow a reduction in the residential rear yard setback along the
  interior east lot line to permit two feet and two inches in lieu of 20 feet; and
  2. Pursuant to LAMC Chapter 1 Section 16.05 and Chapter 1A Section 13B.2.4, a Project Review for a
  development project which creates or results in an increase of 50 or more dwelling units.

  Applicant:  Georgetown 1350 Western, LLC
  Representative: Kyndra Casper, DLA Piper, LLP

  Staff:  Michelle Carter, City Planner
